## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Codex 实例切换到独立配置目录后，本机 `~/.codex/skills` 中的个人技能不可见的问题。受管桌面与 CLI 实例在启动时补齐缺失的技能目录入口，覆盖新建、既有及仅复制会话的实例，适用于原生账号和本地 API 两种连接模式。
- 技能按目录链接至原位置，源技能更新可以继续生效。保留实例中同名的目录、文件及链接；不共享整个技能根目录或 `.system`，不复制登录凭据。直接托管的外部目录继续使用自身配置。权限或路径异常会显示提示并保留现有技能。
- 修复 gzip 解压在等待目标文件打开时可能遗漏错误的竞态，避免损坏或截断的压缩文件触发未捕获异常。

- Fixed personal skills in the local user's `~/.codex/skills` disappearing when Codex instances use a separate configuration home. Managed desktop and CLI instances now add missing skill directory entries at launch, covering new instances, existing instances and session-only copies, in both native-account and local API modes.
- Individual directory links retain source updates and preserve any existing instance directory, file or link with the same name. The entire skills root and `.system` remain separate, and credentials are not copied. Directly adopted external homes retain their own configuration. Permission or path problems produce a notice while preserving existing skills.
- Fixed a gzip extraction race that could lose errors while waiting for the output file to open, preventing uncaught exceptions from corrupt or truncated archives.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。已有受管 Codex 实例下次启动时自动补齐技能入口。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Existing managed Codex instances receive missing skill entries on their next launch. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和兼容 Anthropic Messages 网关连接；客户端需单独安装。本次技能继承只用于 Codex。Claude 的订阅 OAuth、云模式、npm 包装启动器和 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）尚未接入。Claude 模型由连接明确声明，会话管理当前只读。

Codex desktop / CLI and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. Claude connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or gateways compatible with Anthropic Messages. Install clients separately. This skills fix applies to Codex. Claude subscription OAuth, cloud modes, npm wrapper launchers and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are not integrated. Claude models must be declared by the connection; its session management is read-only.

## 验证来源 / Verification

使用真实 Codex CLI **0.162.0-alpha.17.2** 的 `skills/list` 接口在禁止网络的隔离环境验证旧目录不可见、目录链接加载、相同真实路径去重、同名目录保留及系统技能独立性；未创建会话或发起模型请求。另验证实例启动、取消、恢复、复制和文件边界，并运行完整源码回归与打包验收。

Real Codex CLI **0.162.0-alpha.17.2** was tested through `skills/list` in an isolated environment with network access denied, covering missing legacy skills, directory links, canonical-path deduplication, existing directory preservation and separate system skills. No threads or model requests were created. Additional checks cover instance startup, cancellation, recovery, copying and filesystem boundaries, with the full source regression suite and packaged application verification.

版本标签 / Source tag: [v0.7.3](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.7.3). 构建与验收 / Build and verification: [Build release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml). 安装包校验 / Installer checksums: [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.7.3/SHA256SUMS.txt).
